metadataRaw.title: Best Exercises to Realign Your Back and Shoulders
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe goes over the best exercises that can help realign your back and shoulders.

If you feel like something in your upper back and shoulders is out of place, like it needs to be realigned, definitely check this video out.

What usually causes this is a blend of weakness and tightness (in the muscles) that keeps our posture in balance. This includes the trapezius and levator scapulae.

To fix this, we'll go over easy exercises to help stretch and strengthen (these muscles) and bring the upper back and shoulders back in good alignment and posture. 

Watch now and quickly realign your back and shoulders!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:41 Posture Self-Check
1:36 High Shoulder (Strengthen) 
2:59 High Shoulder (Stretch)
5:10 Low Shoulder (Strengthen)
